turns.text: Hello. The print arrived with the wrong colours. The sky is green and it should be blue.

I'm sorry the print arrived with the wrong colours. To help you with this, I need to verify your order first. Could you send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you placed the order with?
Order SC-5219, email nymue.strambu@example.com. It was delivered recently.

Thank you, your order SC-5219 is verified. I have filed a damage claim (request R-1) for the print Cameleonul de noapte, because the sky printed green instead of blue. Staff will review it and ask you for a photo of the print, then decide on the remedy, either a reprint or a refund. The claim is pending until staff approve it. If you already know whether you would prefer a reprint or a refund, tell me and I will note it.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Print 'Cameleonul de noapte' (30x40 cm) arrived with wrong colours: the sky is green but should be blue.

turns.text: I have a photo for the team. I do not know whether I want a reprint or a refund, so I will let them decide after they see the photo.
Thank you. Staff will ask you for the photo, so please keep it ready. They will decide between a reprint and a refund once they have seen it. Your claim R-1 is pending their approval.
